pure-announcement.rationale: A practitioner architecture essay grounded in a production system.

duplicate.rationale: No context-layer or ingestion concept exists in this corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Mechanism arguments (deletion channels, identity resolution ordering) are checkable by construction; the production system is linked.

durability.rationale: The content is distributed-systems mechanics — reconciliation loops, opposite deletion semantics for bounded collections versus unbounded streams, identity resolution as a correctness precondition — none of it tied to a product version.

actionability.rationale: Each section is a concrete architectural decision with its failure mode named; a builder can apply these directly.

atomicity.rationale: At least four separable mechanisms — the datamap ontology, deletion semantics, identity-resolution-before-mining, and connection-health state machines — each promotable on its own; one note would bury them.
